title: Blueprint Round 1: Weberman Residence Open Decisions, Kitchen Calls, Walls And Plaster, Room Layouts, Lighting, Storage, Outdoor Space, Plans And Docs
brands: Blueprint: Max's architecture and interior design agent (Weberman Residence)
White base, Khand/Hind, small pops of real color (zellige green, clay, lagoon, saffron); earthy ok; no neon, pastel, dark rooms, luxe or ornate
